foodSourceRules.notes: Exact published Phase 07 source profiles only; missing measurements are not zero. State, units and serving mass remain explicit.

deficiency.overview: The NHS describes inadequate fluid intake as a cause of dehydration. This article does not diagnose dehydration or quantify an individual deficit.
deficiency.medicalBoundary: Symptoms are nonspecific and cannot diagnose a nutrient deficiency. Diagnosis may require clinical evaluation and appropriate laboratory testing.

excess.overview: This retained NHS source gives hydration guidance rather than a complete excess-fluid safety assessment. No safe maximum or individual drinking prescription is established here.
excess.medicalBoundary: No upper limit is an intake goal. Individual clinical or medical assessment requires a qualified professional.

claims.text: Fluid intake helps maintain hydration; drinks and fluid-containing foods contribute.
claims.population: General source education; no individual diagnostic, athlete supplementation or clinical assessment
claims.limitations: Fluid needs vary with heat, prolonged activity, illness and life stage. No cup-to-gram conversion or personal fluid target is inferred. The source review is overdue.
